summary: OSR Health, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its April 29, 2026 Global Exclusive License Agreement with BCME covering VXM01. The amendment adds Section 6.10, letting OSRH convert up to $15,000,000 of its unexercised put (Equity Option) into a Convertible Note Option purchased at par. Notes issue in four $3.75M tranches at fixed non-reset conversion prices near $2.00, $3.00, $4.00 and $5.00, subject to Nasdaq Minimum Price, closing at least twenty business days after notice. No board recommendation or advisor named; watch Nasdaq delisting overhang and purchaser commitment risk.
